scenes.text: Have you ever wondered what is hiding at the bottom of the ocean?
Right now, in the middle of the Indian Ocean, there is a massive gravity hole where the Earth's gravity is incredibly weak.
Because of this, the sea level actually drops by over three hundred feet, creating a giant dip in the ocean's surface.
But recently, researchers discovered that ancient, sunken tectonic plates dating back over one hundred million years are pulling the Earth's mantle down.
